Plaintiff respectfully moves for leave to proceed in forma pauperis under 28 U.S.C. § 1915(a)(1), and in support states:

1. Plaintiff is unable to pay the fees and costs of this action. The affidavit attached to this motion sets out Plaintiff's assets, income, expenses, and obligations.

2. Plaintiff's action is not frivolous. It asserts that a Member of Congress excluded Plaintiff from a public forum because of the viewpoint Plaintiff expressed, in violation of the First Amendment, and it seeks only declaratory and injunctive relief.

3. Plaintiff requests that the Court direct the United States Marshals Service to serve the summons and complaint under 28 U.S.C. § 1915(d).

WHEREFORE, Plaintiff requests that the Court grant leave to proceed without prepayment of fees and direct service by the United States Marshals Service.

I, [[PLAINTIFF FULL NAME]], being duly sworn, state:

1. I am the plaintiff in this action. I am [[AGE]] years old and reside at [[STREET ADDRESS]], [[CITY]], [[STATE]] [[ZIP]].

2. I am presently [[EMPLOYED / UNEMPLOYED / RETIRED / A STUDENT]]. My occupation is [[OCCUPATION]] and my employer is [[EMPLOYER OR "NONE"]].

3. My total monthly income from all sources is $[[AMOUNT]]. Its sources are [[LIST SOURCES]].

4. The monthly income of my spouse or household member is $[[AMOUNT]] [or "not applicable"].

5. I have $[[AMOUNT]] in cash and $[[AMOUNT]] on deposit at [[FINANCIAL INSTITUTION]].

6. I own the following property of value: [[LIST, INCLUDING APPROXIMATE VALUE; OR "No property other than ordinary household goods."]]

7. My average monthly expenses are: rent or mortgage $[[AMOUNT]]; utilities $[[AMOUNT]]; food $[[AMOUNT]]; transportation $[[AMOUNT]]; medical $[[AMOUNT]]; other $[[AMOUNT]].

8. I [[DO / DO NOT]] receive public benefits. [[IF SO, LIST THEM.]]

9. I [[HAVE / HAVE NOT]] paid a filing fee in another action within the past twelve months. [[IF SO, IDENTIFY THE ACTION.]]

10. I cannot pay the filing fee or give security for it without depriving myself or my dependents of the necessities of life.

I declare under penalty of perjury that the foregoing is true and correct.

Upon consideration of Plaintiff's motion and the affidavit in support, and it appearing that Plaintiff is unable to pay the fees and costs of this action,

IT IS ORDERED that the motion is GRANTED. Plaintiff may proceed without prepayment of fees, and the Clerk shall file the complaint without requiring payment.

IT IS FURTHER ORDERED that the United States Marshals Service shall serve the summons and complaint on the defendants.

<p class="sig">Dated: [[DATE]]<br><br><br>________________________________________<br>United States District Judge</p>
